# Gauri Tichkule

> Gauri Tichkule is a marketing professional based in Milton Keynes, United Kingdom, with 4+ years across US national TV planning and buying, digital advertising, B2B marketing, CRM and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO). She holds an MSc in Strategic Marketing from Cranfield University.

Website: https://gauri-tichkule.vercel.app
Email: gauritichkule@gmail.com
CV: https://gauri-tichkule.vercel.app/Gauri_Tichkule_CV.pdf

## Experience

- B2B Marketing and CRM Intern, Navatech, United Kingdom (Jun 2026 – Aug 2026): optimised 15% of website content for AEO; established off-site brand profiles (Trustpilot) as external trust signals for AI search; authored 4+ blog posts a month for construction industry professionals; created the customer buyer journey that shaped the CRM set-up.
- Executive, Media Planning and Buying, IPG Mediabrands, India (Jun 2024 – Sep 2025): planned and bought US national TV for Merck, Floor & Decor, Eggland's Best and Henkel; negotiated 100+ placements a quarter with 20+ networks and media partners, averaging a 10% saving per campaign; built 50+ media estimates in Media Ocean, cutting planning turnaround by 30%; bi-weekly GRP and unit-count analyses increased viewership engagement by 12%; 95% of activity on target and 97% client retention.
- Platform Support Specialist, Mediamint, India (Sep 2021 – May 2024): executed 150+ paid display, video and retargeting campaigns a month on AdRoll; led CRM integrations for HubSpot, Mailchimp and Marketo; onboarded 50+ advertisers a month; contributed to the AdRoll and Shopify integration; 99.2% customer satisfaction across 20+ client conversations a day; Client's Favourite award four times.

## Education

- MSc Strategic Marketing, Cranfield University (Sep 2025 – Sep 2026), 15% merit scholarship. Thesis: Go-to-Market Strategy for Navatech's Intelligence Layer.
- Bachelor of Business Management, City Premium College, India (Jun 2018 – Aug 2021), CGPA 9.4/10, specialising in marketing.
- PG Certification in Digital Marketing, upGrad and MICA (Dec 2020 – Aug 2021).

## From the MSc

- Managing Brands project (Mar 2026, Cranfield): her learning team built a brand from scratch (logo and identity, brand voice and story, marketing strategy, forecast KPIs) and placed 2nd of 6 competing brand proposals.
- Guest lecture on circular fashion by Tze Ching Yeung (Founder, We Disrupt Agency): reflections on the role of marketing in shifting consumption patterns, and the 5C framework (Circularity, Clarity, Connection, Commercialization, Consistency).
